items.name: ouro-base
items.title: Ouro base
items.description: Installed with every component; you don't need to add it. What every Ouro UI component needs in the app's CSS: success and warning colors, a destructive foreground, the motion tokens, the press utility, the keyframes for spinners, progress bars and skeletons, and --ouro-layer, the z-index of sheets and dialogs (50; raise it in a :root rule of your own if your app has fixed bars above z-50).
items.docs: Ouro UI's base tokens are in your CSS. Your theme's values win: edit them like any shadcn variable. Ouro UI v0.7.0.

@utility press.transition: scale var(--ouro-duration-press) var(--ouro-ease-out), background-color var(--ouro-duration-fast) ease, border-color var(--ouro-duration-fast) ease, color var(--ouro-duration-fast) ease, opacity var(--ouro-duration-fast) ease

items.name: ouro-testing
items.title: Ouro testing
items.description: Installed with every -tests item; you don't need to add it. The test kit Ouro UI's tests use: Vitest browser projects with the drag, flick, tap, touchDrag, touchStep, pointerPress, emulateMedia, pageZoom, resetPageZoom, setPageZoom and restoreTouch commands, the rotate helper (which turns the phone viewport and resets Chromium's zoom; the ouro-touch project fails a test that leaves the page zoomed), the act helper, axeExclude, and the end-to-end story helper.
